FaQ

  • What is the goal of this blog? To spread the word about music news and share our favorite works of music with our audience
  • Do you sell concert tickets directly on this website? No but we provide accurate information which allows our audience to know what artists they can find to buy tickets for
  • How do you determine who makes the "Top Trending Artists" list? We stay up to date with the trends in the media as well as follow the Billboard top 100
  • How do I subscribe to the weekly newsletter? The weekly newsletter sign up is at the bottom of this page! Please sign up. We would love to have you.
  • I found broken links or incorrect information. How do I report it? There is a Contact Us page on the website, in there you will be able to make custom questions and suggestions that go directly to the team.
